verdict.rationale: Multi-channel handling is a fair question for an email or inbox client, since some products in this category add SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat beside email. However, Zero's evidence covers only email. Its "Unified Inbox" connects multiple email providers such as Gmail and Outlook, not non-email channels, so it is adjacent and earns no credit. Nothing in the pack mentions SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live-chat integration.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
